title: Senior Internal Auditor
description:
Our client, a leader in the automotive industry, is seeking a Senior Internal Auditor to join its collaborative audit team in Camden, NJ. This role plays a key part in assessing and improving risk management, controls and governance processes across the organization. You'll conduct audits, lead risk assessments, perform investigations, and provide insights that strengthen their financial, operational, and IT functions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead company-wide risk assessments and control evaluations.

  • Perform audits across financial, operational, and IT areas, including J-SOX compliance.

  • Investigate potential fraud and contribute to special projects.

  • Collaborate with external auditors and co-sourced partners.

  • Supervise junior auditors and guide their professional development.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's preferred.

  • 4–6 years of internal audit or public accounting experience (Big 4 preferred).

  • CPA, CIA, CISA, or CFE (possessing or pursuing at least one).

  • Strong analytical, communication, and project management skills.

  • Proficiency with data analytics tools (Power BI, Tableau, ACL, etc.) and AuditBoard.
  • ​Ability to work onsite at the Camden, NJ office three days per week following 90-day onboarding program. 

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Salary Range: $83,000–$100,000 + bonus eligibility
  • Comprehensive health, pension, and 401(k) match
  • Tuition reimbursement up to $15K annually
  • Vehicle discount programs
  • 15 vacation days, 5 floating holidays, and robust professional development programs

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Join our Camden, NJ client as a Talent Acquisition Partner and help connect exceptional people with meaningful careers. In this contract role, you'll manage full-cycle recruiting—from sourcing and screening candidates to partnering with hiring managers and enhancing the company's brand. You'll play a key role in creating a positive candidate experience and aligning hiring strategies with business needs. Pay range: $45-$53 per hour.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead full-cycle recruitment across various departments, including IT, Engineering, and Automotive.

  • Build and manage pipelines of active and passive talent.

  • Partner with hiring managers to develop effective, inclusive recruiting strategies.

  • Promote employer brand through social media and community engagement.

  • Ensure an excellent candidate experience throughout the process.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in HR, Business, or related field.

  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, preferably in the IT field.

  • Strong communication and relationship management skills.

  • Proficient with ATS systems and sourcing tools.

  • Knowledge of employment laws and best practices.
  • ​Must be commutable to the Camden, NJ office

Work Environment: Hybrid (2 remote days per week after onboarding)

title: Assistant Controller
description:
Our Asset Management client in Philadelphia is looking to hire an Assistant Controller on a direct-hire basis. The ideal candidate will have a nice mix of public/private and at least 5+ years of experience with audit/fund accounting. The Assistant Controller will play a key role in overseeing the client's fund administrators, supporting valuations and reporting, and making sure our partners get the transparency and accuracy they expect.

Salary $160K
Benefits Medical, Dental, Vision, PTO and more!
Schedule M-F (Hybrid schedule) In Office Tue, Wed, and Thur

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee quarterly and annual financial statements and partner capital statements prepared by our fund administrators.

  • Review valuation adjustments and support the Investment Team with quarterly portfolio reporting.

  • Coordinate with auditors and tax advisors during annual audit and tax cycles.

  • Support investor reporting and respond to Partner due diligence questionnaires.

  • Oversee our third-party compliance provider to ensure timely onboarding and monitoring.

  • Assist with capital calls, distributions, and other fund operations.

  • Maintain accurate records, cap tables, and documentation across funds.

  • Assist the Investment Team with decision-making by analyzing financing documents and understanding capitalization structures.

  • Jump in on other projects that keep the finance function and firm running smoothly.

For success, please be aware of expectations:

  • Experience in asset management is highly preferred.

  • At least 5 years of experience with a public/private mix (audit and fund accounting preferred)

  • Pay attention to details. Numbers, statements, and disclosures are precise bto ensure nothing slips through the cracks.

  • Be comfortable in the weeds. Ability to reconcile partner capital, review valuations, and analyze fund models.

  • Be proactive. Don't just process — Anticipate what is needed and bring solutions forward.

  • Have the ability to navigate ambiguity. Fund accounting isn't always black and white, and always be resourceful when situations shift.

  • Be curious about the investment side. Always eager to analyze financing documents, understand complex cap tables, and provide insights that help the Investment Team make better decisions.

  • Be collaborative. Thrive working with our Controller, CFO, auditors, and fund admins to get things right.

  • Be dependable. You know partners and leadership are counting on you, and you deliver consistently.

  • Be growth-minded. Drive to deepen expertise in venture fund accounting and grow into greater responsibility over time.

  • Work well around high performers. Keep professionalism and diplomacy top of mind, especially in high-stakes founder contexts.

title: Assistant Controller
description:
Our client, a leader in agricultural distribution, is looking to add an Assistant Controller to their team in Vineland. This role will support the company's financial operations, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and efficiency across all accounting functions. This role is ideal for a proactive accounting professional who enjoys process improvement, financial reporting, and collaborating across departments in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist in managing accounting, budgeting, and financial reporting processes.

  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.

  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and capital planning initiatives.

  • Perform cash forecasting and variance analysis.

  • Manage month-end close, reconciliations, and journal entries.

  • Drive process improvements and enhance internal controls.

  • Co-supervise staff in Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, and general accounting.

  • Coordinate tax reporting and liaise with external auditors and CPA firm.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance.

  • 5+ years of accounting experience in an industrial or logistics setting; 2+ years supervisory experience.

  • Strong Excel and accounting systems proficiency.

  • Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
  • ​Ability to work fully onsite in Vineland, NJ. This is NOT A REMOTE POSITION.


This is an opportunity to contribute to the next phase of a well-established company's growth journey. You'll work closely with leadership, gain hands-on experience across financial operations, and play a key role in building scalable systems and processes. #EMERSONDHD
